note: Both layerings checked. ConfirmHost wrapping the activity fetch: the soft 200 + x-diq-confirm is settled with no text, and the grant retry, reached through the Confirm button's gesture, announces done only on success. A grant mismatch on the retry is also not announced. Activity fetch outside ConfirmHost: the layer only sees the 428 (asCaller), so it never says done. P3 side note: in that order, Cancel shows FAILED ('could not be completed. Please try again.'), and the busy notice stays up while the box is open. Test comment says this order does not happen in the app.
readJsonCapped(req, 4 KB) runs before schema parse. It handles both a declared Content-Length and a chunked body. Only POST is exported.

bumpDataEpoch() on join and on add, and both callers (filePetition, api/complaints POST) go through addCaseLive. Over-bumps harmlessly when addCase returns null (filing already known). Does not bump when addCase throws partway (rows partly written). AWS backend only, by design.

verdict: broken: the open test reads incidents.is_open only, and a Collector decision never writes it (api/collector/decisions inserts into collector_decisions; consoles use effectiveSql's overlay). (A) A case the Collector resolved/verified/rejected (is_open still 1) is still joined, so the bug still happens. (B) Regression: a case the Collector reopened (pipeline is_open 0, latest decision 'reopen', open on every console) is now refused, and the petition gets a stray case of its own. is_open NULL is treated as closed, which matches the readers' '= 1'. src/lib/manu/cases.ts:138-139

broken: with ward null, the new department arm (all of p.dept_code) shares ORDER BY filed_at DESC LIMIT 200 with the mobile and name arms, which had the 200 rows to themselves before (the ward arm matched ward -1). In a department with 200 newer petitions (Metrowater), the same MOBILE NUMBER's earlier petition is pushed out: no 'second petition on this problem' headline, no attachTo. Regression for every candidate with a mobile but no ward read. Also (medium): with no mobile, ward or street, another 'R.KUMAR' (other ward, other mobile) in the department is now 'this person' and his case is offered. Before the fix only a byte-equal name was fetched. src/lib/manu/repeat.ts:84-88
